summary_en: Wisdom Inc., a special purpose company whose sole shareholder is Kenin Izuten Co. Ltd. (a company controlled by CEO Watanabe Yoshiki), will conduct a public tender offer for all outstanding ordinary shares of Watami Co. Ltd. at 858 yen per share. The board supports the offer and recommends shareholders tender their shares. Following completion, Watami will be delisted and become a private company wholly owned by Wisdom.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of MBO and Recommendation of Tender Offer
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Watami Co. Ltd.'s board of directors unanimously approved and recommended to shareholders a public tender offer for all outstanding ordinary shares by Wisdom Inc., a special purpose acquisition company. Wisdom is wholly owned by Kenin Izuten Co. Ltd., which is controlled by Watami's CEO Watanabe Yoshiki, who currently serves as Wisdom's representative director.

The offer price is set at 858 yen per share, which was the closing price on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market on the last business day prior to the announcement. The target for the tender offer comprises all ordinary shares outstanding, excluding treasury stock. Upon completion of the tender offer and related procedures, Watami will be delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market and become a wholly privately held company. The board's approval was expressly conditioned on the offeror's intention to make Watami a private company with Wisdom as the sole shareholder and on the subsequent delisting of Watami shares.

Class A preferred shares (non-voting) totaling 120 shares are excluded from the tender offer as they fall outside the scope of securities subject to the mandatory tender offer requirements under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act.
